name: W Fort Lauderdale
positioning: A beachfront W hotel on Fort Lauderdale's A1A, with a rooftop pool deck five floors above the Atlantic, oceanfront suites and residential suites with full kitchens
best_for: Beach lovers who want the sand steps from their room
Groups and longer stays that want a residential suite with a full kitchen
Travelers who like a social rooftop pool scene with cabanas

facts.text: W Fort Lauderdale is set along Fort Lauderdale's A1A beachfront.
All hotel rooms include a Bluetooth speaker system, bedside USB ports and a rose gold minifridge.
The rooms have a nautical design.
In Tower I, the Oceanfront Suites have expansive balconies and Atlantic Ocean views, steps from the sand.
AWAY Spa is on the fourth floor of the hotel.
Steak 954 is a steakhouse from restaurateur Stephen Starr serving prime dry-aged beef.
Dogs are welcome, with a W Doggie Bed and a Pet Menu by Stephen Starr.
The hotel's Insider team can help with restaurant reservations, event access and tailored recommendations.
The hotel is conveniently located for Port Everglades cruise port.

highlights.text: WET Deck is a rooftop pool deck five floors above the Atlantic with cocktails, bites and cabana lounging.
A beach of soft golden sand and gentle surf is just steps from the rooms.
In Tower II, the Residential Suites have full kitchens, separate living areas and views of the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic.
On the rooftop, guests can book a private cabana or bungalow with shade, service and a front-row view of the pool.
AWAY Spa offers massages, body treatments, facials, manicures and pedicures, and a Beauty Bar for makeup and hair.

considerations.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes the party-focused environment may not suit guests seeking quiet relaxation.
